verdict.rationale: Cekura documents API key creation restricted to project-level scope, showing some credential scoping capability, but there's no evidence of finer-grained least-privilege controls like read/write permission tiers, resource-specific scoping, or per-agent credential issuance. missing for 10: granular permission scopes (read-only vs write), per-agent or per-resource credential issuance, role-based access control documentation.
